description: Not answering yet: it answers from 17 Nov 2026. No report card is public yet: a card opens two weeks after its server's first read. Until it answers, a call is refused before any payment. Has this MCP server changed since my agent approved it? One signed fact from Agoranome's newest read of a server with a public report card: its grade and score, confirmed stop findings (instructions aimed at the agent, hidden characters, exfiltration links, credential requests), sign-in, the tools it lists and a digest of what a model reads of them (descriptions, parameters and the read-only and destructive hints). Unchanged answers asked with their ETag are a free 304, even after a newer read. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.002 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
